g.title: CMT1A_QSP
g.text: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1A (CMT1A) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
PMP22 gene dosage · Schwann-cell proteostasis · length-dependent axonal supply/demand · motor-unit reserve · 24 modules

g.title: cluster_gen
g.text: 1. The genetic lesion: PMP22 copy number at 17p11.2 (the whole aetiology)

g.title: cluster_prot
g.text: 3. Schwann-cell proteostasis: the fate of the supernumerary PMP22

g.title: cluster_txn
g.text: 2. Transcriptional and post-transcriptional control of PMP22 (where every drug acts)

g.title: cluster_sc
g.text: 4. Schwann-cell state: c-Jun (drawn as interior optimum #2 — REFUTED by diagnostic D14, see below)

g.title: cluster_myelin
g.text: 5. Myelin sheath: thickness, internodal length and the developmental window

g.title: cluster_node
g.text: 6. Node of Ranvier and conduction velocity (the variable that does not move)

g.title: cluster_transport
g.text: 7. Axonal transport: the delivery system whose throughput sets the margin

g.title: cluster_metab
g.text: 8. Schwann-cell to axon metabolic support: myelin as a feeding structure, not an insulator

g.title: cluster_length
g.text: 9. Length-dependence is GEOMETRY: the supply/demand margin along a 1-metre axon

g.title: cluster_degen
g.text: 10. The execution program: how a below-margin axon segment is actually destroyed

g.title: cluster_mu
g.text: 11. Collateral reinnervation reserve: why 80% of motor units can be lost with normal strength

g.title: cluster_muscle
g.text: 12. Muscle: denervation atrophy, fatty replacement and the imbalance that deforms the foot

g.title: cluster_sens
g.text: 13. Sensory system: large-fibre loss, proprioceptive ataxia and the unfelt foot

g.title: cluster_pain
g.text: 14. Pain, cramp and fatigue: the symptoms patients rank highest and trials measure least

g.title: cluster_skel
g.text: 15. Skeletal deformity: an irreversible mechanical record of past muscle imbalance

g.title: cluster_clin
g.text: 16. Clinical endpoints: composite scales, their ceilings and their slopes

g.title: cluster_bio
g.text: 17. Biomarkers ranked by responsiveness (and the one that is structurally useless)

g.title: cluster_pxt
g.text: 18. PXT3003 (baclofen + naltrexone + D-sorbitol): low-dose combination, PMP22 transcription

g.title: cluster_aa
g.text: 19. Ascorbic acid: four null RCTs, and a PK explanation that precedes any question of efficacy

g.title: cluster_oligo
g.text: 20. PMP22-lowering oligonucleotides: the therapeutic window has a FAR WALL (interior optimum #1)

g.title: cluster_other
g.text: 21. Other pharmacological arms: transport, trophic support, hormonal and proteostatic

g.title: cluster_tox
g.text: 22. Neurotoxic drugs: the same margin equation, evaluated at a lower transport velocity

g.title: cluster_mod
g.text: 23. Modifiers and life course: pregnancy, growth, comorbidity, immobilisation

g.title: cluster_trial
g.text: 24. The trial-design layer: why a correct drug can still produce a null result here

g.title: PMP22pt
g.text: toxic species, not a dosage problem

g.title: HEIGHT
g.text: height is a dose variable, not a covariate

g.title: Translate
g.text: PMP22 is inefficiently folded even normally

g.title: Stoich
g.text: the quantity that must be right

g.title: LateEndo
g.text: myelin protein mistrafficked away from membrane

g.title: TransBlock
g.text: myelin protein synthesis falls with it

g.title: SCtrophic
g.text: --- REFUTED: D14 finds this arm is
NEVER a net benefit. Lowering c-Jun
dominates the trophic gain. There is

g.title: NerveUS
g.text: hypertrophy: a trait, not a state

g.title: Lactate
g.text: SC MCT4 - periaxonal space - axon MCT1

g.title: NKA
g.text: rises when conduction is not saltatory

g.title: IntLen
g.text: set in childhood by SC number along axon;

g.title: NCV
g.text: PLATEAUS BY AGE 5 AND STAYS THERE

g.title: DevWin
g.text: birth to ~5 y: internodes and NCV fixed here

g.title: Window_t
g.text: reserve, not age, defines who can still benefit

g.title: CondBlock
g.text: uniform in CMT1A, focal in HNPP

g.title: NCVb
g.text: DERIVATIVE IS ZERO AFTER AGE 5 - unusable

g.title: EndpointCh
g.text: MRI fat fraction >> NfL > CMAP >> CMTNS >> NCV

g.title: TUBAC
g.text: sets kinesin-1 run length and velocity

g.title: Calibre
g.text: reduced in CMT1A - reduced NF spacing

g.title: Demand
g.text: independent of L (arbor size, firing rate)

g.title: Ltrans
g.text: and cargo is consumed en route

g.title: EnergyGap
g.text: demyelinated axon costs more AND is fed less

g.title: mPTP
g.text: point of no return for the segment

g.title: Margin_lo
g.text: no headroom to absorb any transport hit

g.title: Regen
g.text: limited: must re-grow the same 1 m

g.title: CMAPamp
g.text: direct surrogate for surviving motor axons

g.title: Knee
g.text: strength falls only after this point

g.title: ExTrain
g.text: limited but real effect on retained units

g.title: Proprio
g.text: drives ataxia more than weakness does

g.title: ONLS
g.text: arm + leg disability; the PLEO-CMT primary

g.title: PLEO
g.text: ONLS -0.37 vs placebo at high dose;

g.title: AA_plasma
g.text: PLATEAUS near 70-80 uM regardless of dose

g.title: RenalThr
g.text: filtered load above ~60 uM is not reabsorbed

g.title: SVCT2
g.text: Km ~ 20 uM: already saturated at baseline

g.title: DoseGap
g.text: MODEL RESULT: 1.5 g/d and 4 g/d differ

g.title: Nerve_o
g.text: t1/2 weeks - months: the PD driver

g.title: Slowdrug
g.text: Long tissue half-life is PROTECTIVE here
it flattens g and keeps it inside the window

g.title: Titrate
g.text: Dose titration against skin PMP22 mRNA
the only safe way to approach g = 1

g.title: NT3
g.text: TrkC on Schwann cells and axons

g.title: Growth
g.text: axons lengthen faster than they can be supplied

g.title: Ageing
g.text: adds to the disease slope after 60

g.title: SNR
g.text: 12-month signal is a fraction of the noise

g.title: Placebo
g.text: Placebo-arm drift: practice effects on timed tests
can cancel a real drug effect

g.title: L3
g.text: dotted arrow = modulation, weak or conditional link

g.title: L4
g.text: bold node = quantity carried explicitly as a state or key algebraic output in the mrgsolve model

g.title: L5
g.text: g = PMP22 functional dosage relative to normal (2 copies). CMT1A untreated g ~ 1.5; HNPP g ~ 0.5; therapeutic target g = 1.0

g.title: L6
g.text: Margin = delivered axonal supply / terminal demand. Axon degenerates while Margin < 1.
